relay_args_to_page.prompt:

Direction board: ONE 16:9 image made of three stacked 16:3 horizontal YouTube channel banners (top, middle, bottom) separated by thin light gutters. The three directions differ in structure, not only in color: top = brand-led layout with generous white space and one simple graphic device; middle = full-frame illustrated scene spanning the whole banner; bottom = modular grid / node system with the text set inside the grid. All three share the same brand colors, the same Chinese sans-serif typeface and the same copy, exactly as quoted. No panel labels, no captions, no direction names, no fake UI, no buttons, no invented dates, accounts, handles or contact details, no prompt text.
